name: One-Auxiliary Sections Are Strictly Two-Auxiliary Sections
scope: Finite binary classes under the minor-atlas displayed-coordinate conventions.
statement: Allowing a second conditioned coordinate preserves containment, and $(Q_2\setminus\{11\})\times Q_2$ has minimum auxiliary count two.
proof: Allowing a second conditioned coordinate preserves containment, and $(Q_2\setminus\{11\})\times Q_2$ has minimum auxiliary count two.
